title: Exactly Solvable Disorder-free Quantum Breakdown Model: Spectrum, Thermodynamics, and Dynamics
summary: We introduce and study a disorder-free version of the quantum breakdown model with all-to-all interactions. The Hamiltonian factorizes into the product of the zero-momentum-mode occupation number and a quadratic Hamiltonian including only pairing terms. This structure makes the model exactly solvable and produces an extensive zero-energy degeneracy. We obtain the spectrum and partition function in closed form and analyze the thermodynamics, spectral form factor, two-point functions, and a regulated out-of-time-ordered correlator (OTOC).
